umbrella: An umbrella is a tool to keep you dry when it rains. You hold it over your head.
I use my umbrella when it rains.
An umbrella company is an organization that controls other organizations.
The store was under the company umbrella.
umpteen: Umpteen is a large number of something; more than some.
What have you been doing for the last umpteen days?
um: You use um to show that you are thinking and not ready to speak.
We were prepared, um, in our minds, in our heart, for -- for whatever.
You use um to show that you doubt or are not sure about something somebody said.
Um, I don't think that works.
You use um with a falling tone to show that you agree.
How does Tuesday sound?" "Um, sure. Sounds good!
You use um to get somebody's attention.
Um, excuse me! Are you busy?
You use um to bring attention to something that just happened or that was just said.
Um, did you just call me "stupid"?
umbrage: To take umbrage is to have a feeling of anger or annoyance caused by something offensive.
umpire: An umpire is a person who presides over a sports event and enforces its rules.
If you umpire, you act as an umpire in a game.
umber: Umber is a brownish-gray color, somewhat darker than ochre.
